solution_summary: To continue to extend its cutting-edge solution and service offerings, Accenture needed to enhance its infrastructure and unify operations to support more simplified and accelerated digital transformation for current and future customers. The company chose RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure as a comprehensive solution to enhance security, interoperability, and innovation and to simplify infrastructure management. By using RISE with SAP on Azure, Accenture strengthened its infrastructure and improved integration of financial data, reporting capabilities, and transaction processing across multiple lines of business and regions—all of which is critical for regulatory compliance and operational resilience.

To continue to extend its cutting-edge solution and service offerings, Accenture needed to enhance its infrastructure and unify operations to support more simplified and accelerated digital transformation for current and future customers. The company chose RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure as a comprehensive solution to enhance security, interoperability, and innovation and to simplify infrastructure management.

As one of the world’s largest professional services companies, Accenture helps its customers transform every part of their business by bringing together all applications, services, and data in the cloud to create a strong digital core. With this foundation, all business areas can be unified through automated, intelligent processes that also integrate customers and partners into the value chain.
